key_decisions.decision: Unfolds oath-bound testimony condition while retaining both seeing and knowing and liability for silence; note preserves curse aspect of oath.
Keeps three carcass categories, unawareness and both ritual uncleanness and guilt without making all animal touch immoral.
Retains broad human impurity, initial unawareness and subsequent knowledge without inventing the specific contact.
Preserves harm/good range, repeated rashness, oath and awareness sequence without adding deliberate lying.
Renders asham here as reparation so the stated sin offering is not confused with the distinct ram guilt offering below; keeps female alternatives.
Retains economic alternative, exact two birds, two species choices and different offering roles for each bird.
Keeps sin offering first and neck action without complete separation, distinct from chapter 1’s bird burnt offering.
Distinguishes sprinkling from draining and side from base; retains offering category.
Preserves second economic accommodation, exact tenth-ephah and both prohibited additions, contrasting chapter 2.
Keeps breach of trust, unintentional holy-property offense, unblemished ram and second-person valuation in sanctuary shekels without inventing a sum.
Preserves restitution plus fifth and priest recipient, distinct from sacrificial ram; the holy-property loss remains concrete.
Retains liability despite ignorance and repeated guilt-bearing claim without adding deliberate intent.
Keeps assessed ram, priest transfer, repeated unintentional/unaware language and forgiveness.
Preserves asham wordplay and emphatic guilt without collapsing offering and liability into one referent.
